rejected.v2.3.0: superseded by v2.3.1 and v2.3.2 within the same line
rejected.v3.0.0-beta2.patch1: targets the Isaac Sim 6.0 line; the standing instructions forbid a 6.x move without a dedicated compatibility and revalidation tranche
rejected.main: untagged and moving; the current editable install already tracks it, which is the condition this plan exists to end

version_selection.verified_from: the v2.3.2 tag's own docs/source/setup/installation/*.rst, not the develop documentation

existing_installation_left_untouched.risk_accepted_for_now: an editable install tracking main can change the environment without anything in this repository changing. Accepted because navfm imports nothing from Isaac Lab; it stops being acceptable the day a navfm module does.
existing_installation_left_untouched.detection: navfm.simenv records the Isaac Lab version, clone commit, tag and worktree cleanliness in every harness provenance block, so a change becomes visible in the artefact rather than invisible.

planned_isolation.method: git worktree, not a second clone

correction_to_the_plan_as_written.issue: the plan's commands begin `cd ~/projects/IsaacLab`; no such directory exists
correction_to_the_plan_as_written.git_fetch_not_required: v2.3.0, v2.3.1 and v2.3.2 are already present locally; 32 tags fetched

planned_isolation.caveat_on_do_not_touch: `git worktree add` writes metadata into the existing clone's .git directory and registers the new worktree. It does not change that clone's HEAD, branch or working files, and it does not alter the installed editable packages, which resolve to source/ paths in the original checkout. This is a departure from a literal reading of 'do not touch' and is recorded rather than glossed.
planned_isolation.alternative_if_that_is_unacceptable: a fresh `git clone --branch v2.3.2 --depth 1` into a separate directory, which touches nothing at all and costs roughly 270 MB more

blocking_condition.blocker: root filesystem within hours of full
required_before_installation: close the producing desktop application normally
verify the log has stopped growing
blocking_condition.rationale: a full filesystem can corrupt environments, leave partial package installs, and damage evidence artefacts. Installation while within hours of full is not attempted.

hardware_caveat.claim_boundary: the host does NOT meet the recommended specification and this must not be claimed. Being under a documented baseline is a reason to benchmark conservatively; it is not evidence that Isaac Lab will fail to run.

scaling_protocol.expectation: state-only environments are expected to scale far better than camera-based ones, because vectorising also vectorises render products, camera buffers and model inputs. A low camera-environment ceiling is an acceptable outcome.

hardware_caveat.preferred_architecture: large-scale cheap state/geometry generation, then a smaller RGB rendering subset for GNM/ViNT/NoMaD images, rather than continuous full-resolution RGB in every parallel environment

relationship_to_bo10.isaac_lab_is: parallel infrastructure development, not a prerequisite
relationship_to_bo10.must_not: BO-10 is not moved onto Isaac Lab until the official-loader compatibility deliverable is closed
relationship_to_bo10.motivating_problem: the straight-route finding -- 84/96 Office and 73/96 Hospital candidates have zero qualifying turns because a shortest-path planner string-pulls routes straight. An episode-distribution task generator is a cleaner home for turn and junction requirements than further extending the collector.
relationship_to_bo10.still_required_first: a NEW preregistered turning-route experiment, whose generator, budget, seed and eligibility rules are declared before any candidate is evaluated. Isaac Lab is a possible implementation of that generator, not a substitute for preregistering it.

non_claims: No Isaac Lab installation was performed.
No existing environment, clone or checkout was modified.
No BO-10 result depends on Isaac Lab.
